mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_records(order_id, package_id, merchant_shipment_no, carrier, tracking_number, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{packageId}, #{merchantNo}, #{carrier}, #{tracking}, 'REQUESTED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = order_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND package_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT order_id,MAX(delivered_at) AS delivered_at FROM shipment_records WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL AND package_delivery_reported=FALSE GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*)=COUNT(delivered_at) AND (MAX(package_delivery_checked_at) IS NULL OR MAX(package_delivery_checked_at) < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-15,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY MAX(package_delivery_checked_at),order_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET package_delivery_checked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), package_delivery_reported=package_delivery_reported OR #{reported} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND package_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} AND replacement=#{replacement}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_records(order_id, after_sale_id, order_number, merchant_shipment_no, carrier, tracking_number, status, replacement) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{afterSaleId}, #{orderNumber}, #{merchantNo}, #{carrier}, #{tracking}, 'REQUESTED', #{replacement})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE after_sale_id IS NOT NULL AND platform_shipment_no IS NULL AND (last_reconciled_at IS NULL OR last_reconciled_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_reconciled_at, created_at), id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET platform_shipment_no = #{platformNo}, shipped_at = COALESCE(shipped_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND platform_shipment_no IS NULL

UPDATE shipment_records SET status = #{status}, last_event_at = #{occurredAt}, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELIVERED' THEN #{occurredAt} ELSE delivered_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE merchant_shipment_no = #{merchantNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE (after_sale_id IS NULL AND status <> 'DELIVERED' OR after_sale_id IS NOT NULL AND platform_shipment_no IS NOT NULL AND (status <> 'DELIVERED' OR last_reconciled_at IS NULL OR last_reconciled_at < delivered_at)) AND COALESCE(last_reconciled_at, updated_at) <= #{updatedBefore} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_reconciled_at, updated_at), id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET platform_shipment_no = #{platformNo}, carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, status = CASE WHEN last_event_at IS NULL THEN #{status} ELSE status END, shipped_at = COALESCE(shipped_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE shipment_records SET carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, shipment_version = #{version}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbound_order_id = #{orderId} AND shipment_version < #{version}

UPDATE shipment_records SET status = #{status}, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELIVERED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_at, #{occurredAt}) ELSE delivered_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, status, location, description, occurred_at FROM shipment_events WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY occurred_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO shipment_notifications( shipment_id, notification_id, signature_valid, processing_status, payload_digest, failure_reason, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{shipmentId}, #{notificationId}, TRUE, #{processingStatus}, #{digest}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET last_reconciled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), reconciliation_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
